notes.title: Achievements Live and Running!
notes.notes:
Dear tactiсians!

As promissed, we are delivering the Achievemenrs system. Now you can finally register your success and show it to others! In order to prevent players from farming stats through repeating one mission again and again, we decided that stats of weapon usage and civil saving will be counted in the system ONLY for sucessfull mission and ONLY for the first sucessfull attempt!

Since it was our failure not to deliver achievements at the launch day, all your recorded missions will be included in the stats since the May 28, according to the rules above!

Have fun, learn the conflict, be tacticool!

notes.title: What is sold in the game
notes.notes:
Tacticians!

There are many speculations that our game Squad 22: ZOV is expensive. Mostly it is written by people not playing it and judging from somme in-game screens. So, let us explain what is there to buy and if you have to buy it actually.

After you download the game, you can play 2 missions for free to see if you like it. It is a Tutorial mission and Mission #1 from Mariupol campaign (the shortest mission). After that you can decide what period of the ongoing conflict you are interested in to understand better and lead your squad through.

1. For [b]$5.99[/b] (set price) you can unlock[b] Donbass Spring campaign[/b]. 17 missions of 2014 fights. Specifics of this period means you controll basically militia, not regular army. So resourses are scarced and it is not easy to manage them. As in real lfe, some people started defending Donbass having just a twin-barrel hunting shotgun IZh-27.

2. For [b]$11.99 [/b](set price) you can unlock [b]Mariupol (2022) and AFU Counteroffensive (2023) campaigns[/b], 15 missions each. These campaigns already represent regular army forces of the Russian Military and you will get supplies of assault rifles, machineguns, rocket launchers, drone support and more from early missions.

That is it. The remaining more expensive options (collector bundles) are just for those, who want soome purely cosmetic things: better HQ decorations and some extra real life soldiers in squads (with normal, not blown-up stats). You [b]DO NOT NEED to buy them[/b] to play the game. We added those bundles just to give players option to express their gratitude towards out work and give us extra resourses to work on improving the game. And the fact that they are being bought means people want to see us working more (here goes Summer vacation season ːsteamsadː )

So, do not pay extra, uf you don't want to. 
Hope that helps!

notes.title: The game is released, achievements to follow
notes.notes:
Friends, followers!

The game is finally released on Steam. Play, enjoy. May be it is far from the best games out there, but we've tried to do a decent work.

As for achievements: their progress is already recorded (for successful missions only), but they will be updated on Steam API within a few days.
